messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for The King & Queen?
messages.body:
Hi Kathy,

Thanks for letting me know, no worries at all.

If you do look at new acts again, it would be great if you could have a
quick listen to Jake's recordings on his website first, or show them to a
few of your regulars and see if they'd want to see Jake Essex at The King &
Queen. He's always around your area and gives an unforgettable night to
everyone who comes along.

For when the time is right, Jake is £300 cash for two one hour sets, or
£250 a night if you book four dates. Three sets are £350 for one night, or
£300 a night for four. He brings his own PA and there's no deposit.

A few free Saturdays:
November: Sat 7th
January: Sat 2nd, Sat 9th
March: Sat 6th, Sat 27th

Natalie
Bookings for Jake Essex
